Description.name: Rare Wynq
Description.description: Well I say! Rare Wynq is a dashing Monster indeed, boldly sporting its finely-groomed fluffstache and distinguished bouffante at every gala this socialite graciously graces. Its appearance befits the Rare's aristocratic status: it is universally respected and revered by its peers for its poise, sophistication, and regal refinement. It's simply good breeding!
